passages.text: The science club brings a toy car to the school open day. A small battery gives the motor power to turn the wheels. Before each test, the visitors count to three and shout, “Go!” together. Ben marks the stopping place with a card so everyone can compare the runs. Mia explains that they change only one thing at a time, such as the wheels. The younger children enjoy guessing the car's stopping place and checking their ideas. The demonstration gives everyone a chance to ask questions instead of only watching.

parallelText.en: The science club brings a toy car to the school open day.
parallelText.zh: 科学社团把一辆玩具车带到学校开放日。

parallelText.en: A small battery gives the motor power to turn the wheels.
parallelText.zh: 一块小电池给电机提供能量，带动轮子。

parallelText.en: Before each test, the visitors count to three and shout, “Go!” together.
parallelText.zh: 每次测试前，访客数到三，一起大喊“出发！”

parallelText.en: Ben marks the stopping place with a card so everyone can compare the runs.
parallelText.zh: 本用卡片标记停车位置，让大家比较各次行驶。

parallelText.en: Mia explains that they change only one thing at a time, such as the wheels.
parallelText.zh: 米娅解释，他们一次只改变一件东西，例如轮子。

parallelText.en: The younger children enjoy guessing the car's stopping place and checking their ideas.
parallelText.zh: 较小的孩子喜欢猜车的停车位置，再核对想法。

parallelText.en: The demonstration gives everyone a chance to ask questions instead of only watching.
parallelText.zh: 这次演示让大家有机会提问，而不仅仅观看。

wordHelp.meaning: a machine part that produces movement
showing how something works

passages.text: At the space museum, our class watches a film about a rocket. The vehicle stands on the ground while a team checks its equipment. They test the instruments before they launch it into the sky. The film shows that many people have different jobs before the journey begins. After watching, we put picture cards in the order shown on the screen. Mia adds notes about checking, waiting and finally leaving the ground. Our display focuses on preparation, not just the exciting moment at the end.

parallelText.en: At the space museum, our class watches a film about a rocket.
parallelText.zh: 在航天博物馆，我们班看了一部关于火箭的影片。

parallelText.en: The vehicle stands on the ground while a team checks its equipment.
parallelText.zh: 飞行器停在地面上，团队检查它的设备。

parallelText.en: They test the instruments before they launch it into the sky.
parallelText.zh: 把它发射升空前，他们测试仪器。

parallelText.en: The film shows that many people have different jobs before the journey begins.
parallelText.zh: 影片展示，旅程开始前许多人承担不同工作。

parallelText.en: After watching, we put picture cards in the order shown on the screen.
parallelText.zh: 看完后，我们按屏幕上的顺序排列图片卡。

parallelText.en: Mia adds notes about checking, waiting and finally leaving the ground.
parallelText.zh: 米娅加上关于检查、等待、最后离地的记录。

parallelText.en: Our display focuses on preparation, not just the exciting moment at the end.
parallelText.zh: 我们的展示重点是准备过程，而不仅是最后激动人心的一刻。

wordHelp.meaning: tools used to check or measure things
work done to get ready for something
